system.flavor:
Light a dark room, read a page by its glow, or signal across a valley at night. Mark one object so it stays visible for the scene.

Not enough to blind a watcher, burn anything, or light more than one room.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Radiant Damage. The target sheds visible light in its space until the start of your next turn; this does not reveal creatures other than it.

surges.html: Ignore ordinary darkness penalties for this attack.
On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Light Thread
rider.html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.
